{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check association between arm and severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()}")"}
